scope: Cold fresh-process candidate output; frozen medium aggregate selects; heldout and hard reported separately. Large equality is cross-method evidence, not an independent exhaustive oracle.

manifest.warmup: one one-state fresh-process warmup per case and algorithm outside measured trials
manifest.process_policy: one measured child at a time; no parallel benchmark workers started by this harness
manifest.competing_load_note: Host released by root after T1 and separate resident experiment; no competing benchmark/oracle workers; serial fresh-process T2 trials
manifest.selection_rule: Lowest sum of complete per-case median compute time with exact candidate agreement; report overlapping ranges as uncertain.
